sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface display confirmed (pRK5 vector, described as surface-displayed tagged receptors); functional assays not reported in this clip. L3 additionally confirms surface localization in hippocampal neurons via cell-impermeable nanobody labeling. L4 confirms endogenous surface expression in neurons under non-permeabilized conditions.
sites.rationale: All four ledger lines (L1–L4) independently place a tag at the extracellular N-terminus of mGluR5, after the signal peptide cleavage site. Python-verified: signal peptide ends at residue 20 (A), mature protein begins at residue 21 (Q); insert_after_residue=20 places the tag on the extracellular face, well upstream of TM1 (residues 580–604), satisfying the ≥3-residue TM-distance constraint. L2 is chosen as primary because it uses full-length receptor, explicitly states surface display, and covers multiple tag chemistries (HA, SNAP, FLAG, CLIP). The position is validated (not merely topology-derived) because both L1 and L2 explicitly state 'after the signal peptide', uniquely pinning the junction to residue 20/21. Full-length human mGluR5 expressed in pRK5 with an N-terminal signal peptide followed immediately by HA, SNAP, FLAG, or CLIP tags; constructs described as surface-displayed tagged receptors. Signal peptide spans residues 1–20 (landmark-verified), so the tag is inserted after residue 20 (A) and before residue 21 (Q). Additionally supported by L1 (Twin Strep-Tag II after signal peptide in a 1–839 truncated construct), L3 (extracellular SEP tag on full-length mGluR5 in hippocampal neurons, surface-detected by cell-impermeable GFP nanobody), and L4 (ORANGE GFP endogenous knock-in at the N-terminus, surface-detected by anti-GFP under non-permeabilized conditions).

sources.claim: All SNAP- or CLIP-tagged mGluR2 (rat), mGluR3 (rat), mGluR5 (human), mGluR7 (rat), mGluR8 (human), V2R (human), β2AR (human) were generated with an N-terminal signal peptide from rat mGluR5 followed by variable combinations of HA-, SNAP-, FLAG-, or CLIP in the pRK5 vector as previously described 54 .

literature_notes: All four ledger lines (L1, L2, L3, L4) converge on the same N-terminal junction (insert_after_residue=20, after signal peptide cleavage). No ledger line provides evidence for any internal extracellular loop site (ECL1 638–641, ECL2 715–737, ECL3 794–798) or for the C-terminal intracellular tail. L1 uses a truncated construct (residues 1–839) but the N-terminal tag position is unaffected by C-terminal truncation. L3 (SEP, a ~240 aa GFP-like protein) and L4 (GFP KI) demonstrate the N-terminal extracellular position tolerates even large insertions, further supporting tolerance of a short ALFA-tag (~15–23 aa). Because all four lines pin the identical junction, this is reported as one site with L2 as the primary clip. No ledger line supports any other extracellular surface site.
